review_description: Wide Bay Solar have  been extremely professional.  The work, advice and help with all aspects of the job from start to finish rate no less then a ten.

When my inverter died 2 1/2 years after initial installation, I sent Michael from WBS a video of the error procedure upon start up. He was around with a new inverter free of charge and zero installation cost within a few days. Now 3 years with the system and this has been my only hassle with a Sunny Boy inverter and Bosch panels. Very positive review.

The service received was the best service I have received from an electrican ever, communication was terrific and all questions answered in plain English and they did not leave a mess after the job was finished. Quality of work and system operation explained.
I had to wait a little longer than expected to get the panels I had ordered (Bosch), so lost a month but all in all a good team and good experience with them.
